SPECIFICATION FOR 
CAPACITORS FOR RADIO INTERFERENCE SUPPRESSION 

PART 2 TYPE FCRS 1 



0. General —This standard shall be read in conjunction with IS : 3723 (Part 1) -1978 'Capacitors for 
radio interference suppression : Part 1 General requirements and methods of test ( first revision )'. 

1. Outline Drawing and Dimensions — The outline drawing and dimensions shall be in accordance 
with Fig. 1 and Table 1 .

3. Constructional Details 

3.1 A capacitor whose one terminal is connected to the centre conductor which carries the current and 
the other terminal connected to the metallic case — which is normally earthed. The dielectric used shall 
be polyethylene terapthalate ( polyester )/kraft paper and the aluminium foil is used as the electrode. 
Extended foil construction is employed. 



4. Marking — See 7 of IS: 3723 ( Part 1 )-1978. 



5. Classification of Tests — See 8.1 of IS : 3723 ( Part 1 )-1978. 



5.1 General Conditions of Tests and Methods of Test — See 8.2 of IS : 3723 ( Part 1 )-1978. 



5.2 Schedule of Type Tests — The test schedule and the specific requirements shall be in accordance 
with Table 2
